scope: Talvora project-delivery enforcement. This change adds the mandatory Awwwards delivery gate itself and does not redesign a user-facing product surface.
designDecisions: Every Talvora project delivery must carry fresh Awwwards evidence; projects with creative/UI work cannot be pushed or published through Talvora without an Awwwards reference.
This enforcement change has no end-user visual redesign, so the recorded design decision is explicit non-UI applicability rather than invented visual review evidence.
